args.body: Take OPIRE-SPECIFIC-PAID-REPAIR after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. I read the prior rejection: Opire had readable advertised USD rewards and a PR/claim route, but no specific task was inspected. That narrower gap justifies this finite test; it does not justify repeating generic GitHub discovery. Explicit autonomous-agent invitation is not a universal prerequisite for internal preparation; inspect each repository's actual rules and disclose AI production truthfully. Prepare a repair only when source and acceptance evidence support it. Submission and settlement dependencies remain explicit. Stop within the mission bounds. Five unclassified feedback sources mean demand unknown; no funds or revenue verified. Preserve every existing deadline and retirement.

description: The prior Opire rejection inspected no actual task; its official page advertises USD bounties and a pull-request claim route. Test specific tasks rather than repeat generic GitHub searches. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; funding and revenue remain unverified. Account access blocks submission, but need not block a useful offline repair.
